meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 画出代码改动或系统结构的动态架构图与数据流图,让变更一眼看懂
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要跟人解释一段代码改动或系统结构,却只能靠文字硬讲
copy.tagline_en: Draw a code change or system as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often explain code changes or systems and words alone fall short

howto.what: 它把一次代码改动、或代码库的一部分,画成带动画的架构图或数据流图,渲染为动画 SVG。也能把图推成一条网页画布链接,或附进 Pull Request 的描述里。
howto.when: 当你要求把一个改动或系统画成图、可视化或解释清楚,或一个 Pull Request 需要配图时触发;提到 diagram、architecture、data flow 等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 把这个 PR 的改动画成架构图,放到 canvas 上给我链接
say.note: 渲染并推送画布,返回免登录的视图链接

say.text: 给这个分支的改动画一张数据流图
say.note: 写出 graph.json、校验通过后渲染出 SVG

say.text: 把架构图附到 12 号 PR 的描述里
say.note: 用 gh pr edit 把图上传进描述

howto.what_en: PR Lens turns a code change, or part of a codebase, into animated architecture or data-flow diagrams rendered as animated SVG. It can also push a diagram to a canvas link, or attach it to a pull request description.
howto.when_en: Use it when asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram — including on keywords like diagram, architecture, data flow.

say_en.text: Draw this PR's change as an architecture diagram and give me the canvas link
say_en.note: Renders and pushes the canvas, returns a no-login view link

say_en.text: Make a data-flow diagram for the changes on this branch
say_en.note: Writes graph.json, validates it, then renders SVG

say_en.text: Attach the architecture diagram to PR #12's description
say_en.note: Uses gh pr edit to upload the diagram
